flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4313/#HelloThere then Find the tiddler titled 'HelloThere' and click the edit button (pencil icon) at its top right. If the pencil is not visible, click the small down arrow at the tiddler's top right and choose 'edit' in the menu.
Wait until the tiddler is in edit mode, with a large text box for its content.
Scroll the page if needed so that the row of formatting icons (bold, italic and others) directly above the large text box is near the top of the screen, with plenty of empty space below it.
Is this true right now: "The tiddler HelloThere is in edit mode, and a row of formatting icons such as bold and italic is visible directly above its large text box."? If it is true, @v16:"store the word yes as 'ready'". If it is not true, @v16:"store the word no as 'ready'".
In the row of formatting icons directly above the large text box, click the down arrow icon that opens more toolbar buttons. It is near the right end of the row, just to the left of the eye (preview) icon. Do not click the arrow to the right of the eye icon. A dropdown opens and must stay open; do not click anything else.
Wait 2 seconds.
Then stop.
